pixel_convention: x right, y down, full-resolution pixels; t = frame/24
view: top-down (nadir) view of snowy ground; jet flies over three parked tanks, right to left

camera.evidence: phase correlation of background strip vs frame 0: |shift| < 0.02 px all frames

jet.desc: grey swept-wing jet aircraft seen from above, two underwing missiles/pods each side, nose pointing left (-x)
jet.reference_point: bbox centre (assumed origin) ref_x = bbox centre x, ref_y = 729.0
jet.size_note: length includes the missile tips that protrude ahead of the nose (missile tip x=1116 at f24; tail-cone tip x=1678). Size constant over clip (no altitude change).
jet.motion: pure translation along -x, y constant (dy=0 +-1 px), no rotation; frames 0 and 1 are identical; motion starts frame 1->2

shell.desc: small dark elongated projectile/shell on or above the ground, left of the lower tank, ~same row as its gun barrel (y~983)
shell.moves: only between frames 1 and 2 (blurred streak centred x~838 in frames 0-1, sharp at x~797 from frame 2 on)

tank_upper_left.desc: dark slate tank, upper-left of the three; hull axis along x; turret rotated, gun barrel points up-left (tip ~ (1130,425), not in mask)

tank_middle_right.desc: dark slate tank, middle/right of the three (at jet fuselage row); hull along x; barrel points left (-x), barrel tip x=1576

tank_lower.desc: dark slate tank, lowest of the three; hull along x; barrel points left (-x), barrel tip x=1235, in line with the shell

events.event: frames 0 and 1 identical (jet and shell not yet moved)
first motion: jet starts moving left (step frame1->2 ~34 px); shell jumps ~41 px left and then stays still
jet front (missile tips) reaches left image edge
jet reference point (bbox centre) leaves the image
last frame: only jet tail-cone tip visible at the left edge; jet still moving

ground_features: snow patches (bright bluish) and dark brown vegetation/earth; a lighter diagonal snow band from upper right through lower middle; no road markings
